visualCharacteristics.purpose: centred campaign slider with peeking neighbouring slides and dot pagination
visualCharacteristics.description: Dark red (#B51824) background, 72px padding. Centered slider of red campaign cards (H2, text, outlined white CTA on the left, photo on the right), peeking next slide, dot pagination.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cell 1 = image only; cell 2 = heading, paragraph, CTA link
contentPattern.description: Interactive slider of 3 campaign slides with dot pagination and peeking adjacent slides.

usage: Campaign/brand stories section. Clicking a peeking slide brings it to the centre.
reuseGuidance: Use when one slide should be in focus with adjacent slides partially visible. For full-width slides use carousel-hero.
